assessment.reason: The projected mean sits just under 1.5 with a median of one, and plus money lowers the break-even. The model clears break-even even at the low end of its sensitivity range.
assessment.model_case: Projected 23.6 minutes yields about 1.48 shots, essentially at the line. The case rests on the separately shrunk shot rate. If shrinkage understates a high-volume shooter, the under weakens quickly.
assessment.price_case: Main 1.5 at +135 needs a win rate in the low forties. Three other books price the over as a solid favorite. A heavy market weighting would leave only a thin cushion.
assessment.context_case: Matheson's listed absence could raise Hutson's minutes or power-play load, which works against the under. That absence predates his last game, so recent usage may already reflect it. The VSIN piece does not address this prop.

qualitative_review.countercase: Four books setting the under at plus money imply the market sees him clearing 1.5 regularly. If extra minutes or top power-play duty from Montreal's injuries push his volume up, the near-line mean could understate him and the under loses its edge.
